Heey dude,
we have a Map making section, there you can post unfinished maps and you'll get feedback what you can add and so on...
But anyways, the server uses a file named YML to know where the spawn is, with what the players spawn... You can try to code it yourself via http://docs.avicus.net/ or I'll can do it for you. Just contact me via skype: flo.schmenni , If you have any request regarding your map, you can ask me aswell :D
